classification.difficultyReason: Translate north and east displacements into a horizontal right triangle, combine its distance with the previously calculated tree height, and convert a horizontal angle into a northwest true bearing.

content.prompt: The base of a tree is situated 50 metres due north of a point $P$. The angle of elevation of the top of the tree from $P$ is $32^\circ$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the height of the tree, correct to one decimal place.

answer.worked:
Let $O$ be the base and $T$ the top of the tree. In the vertical right triangle $POT$:
$$\begin{align*}\tan32^\circ&=\frac{OT}{50}\\OT&=50\tan32^\circ\\OT&\approx31.2\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$
Retain $50\tan32^\circ$ for subsequent calculations.

children.label: b
children.prompt: $Q$ is a point 100 metres due east of $P$. Find:

children.label: i
children.prompt: the distance of $Q$ from the base of the tree

answer.worked:
Let $O$ be the base of the tree. Since north and east are perpendicular, $\angle OPQ=90^\circ$. By Pythagoras’ theorem:
$$\begin{align*}QO^2&=50^2+100^2\\QO^2&=12500\\QO&=50\sqrt5\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: the angle of elevation of the top of the tree from $Q$, correct to one decimal place

answer.worked:
Let $\theta=\angle TQO$, where $O$ and $T$ are the base and top of the tree. In the vertical right triangle $QOT$, use the unrounded height:
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=\frac{OT}{QO}\\\tan\theta&=\frac{50\tan32^\circ}{50\sqrt5}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\tan32^\circ}{\sqrt5}\right)\\\theta&\approx15.6^\circ.\end{align*}$$

children.label: iii
children.prompt: the bearing of the tree from $Q$, correct to one decimal place

answer.worked:
Let $O$ be the base of the tree and $\alpha=\angle PQO$. The tree is north of west from $Q$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\alpha&=\frac{50}{100}\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac12\right).\end{align*}$$
The clockwise bearing from north is:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing}&=270^\circ+\tan^{-1}\left(\frac12\right)\\\text{Bearing}&\approx296.6^\circ\mathrm{T}.\end{align*}$$
